comparisons.peer_topic: Pensando Acquisition Transaction Details and Purchase Price Allocation
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD completed the acquisition of Pensando for approximately $1.9 billion on May 26, 2022, with a recorded purchase consideration of $1.7 billion net of adjustments. The consideration was allocated to $349 million in intangible assets, $208 million in identifiable net assets, and $1.1 billion in goodwill.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures detail significant capital structure adjustments in their financial notes, but they involve different financial instruments and transaction directions. Intel sold a 49% stake in a VIE (Ireland SCIP) to Apollo, raising $11.0 billion in net proceeds and increasing capital in excess of par value, while retaining ownership of the underlying asset (Fab 34). In contrast, AMD details the allocation of purchase consideration for an acquisition (Pensando), which resulted in recording goodwill and intangible assets rather than generating immediate capital proceeds from an equity sale. Intel's transaction increases equity capital, whereas AMD's allocation reflects the assignment of acquisition cost.

sentences.text: In the second quarter of 2024, we closed a transaction with Apollo Global Management, Inc. (Apollo) involving the sale of 49% of our interest in an Irish limited liability company (Ireland SCIP) for net proceeds of $11.0 billion, which increased our capital in excess of par value.
The purchase consideration was allocated to $349 million of intangible assets, $208 million of identifiable net assets, and $1.1 billion of goodwill.
